tasks.title: Add rebaseOntoMaster, abortRebase, continueRebase to WorktreeManager
tasks.description: Add three new methods to WorktreeManager: rebaseOntoMaster() fetches origin/baseBranch and runs git rebase inside the worktree, returning {success, conflicts}; abortRebase() runs git rebase --abort; continueRebase() runs git rebase --continue. Extract conflict file paths from git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U when rebase fails.
acceptanceCriteria: rebaseOntoMaster() returns {success:true, conflicts:[]} on clean rebase
abortRebase() restores branch to pre-rebase state
continueRebase() returns success when conflicts are staged and resolved
continueRebase() returns new conflicts if more arise
tasks.notes: New methods are additive — no changes to existing create/remove/list methods

tasks.title: Simplify mergeBack to fast-forward only
tasks.description: Replace the current three-way merge logic in mergeBack() (git merge --no-edit) with git merge --ff-only. Remove the stash/uncommitted-changes logic — that moves to rebaseOntoMaster. Keep the commit-uncommitted-changes-before-merge guard (stage any leftover files in worktree before merge). Keep the hasCommits check and cleanup logic.
acceptanceCriteria: mergeBack() uses git merge --ff-only instead of git merge --no-edit
Returns {success:false} with descriptive message when fast-forward is not possible
Does NOT modify base branch on failure
Existing remove/cleanup after successful merge still works

tasks.title: Update MergeState type and MergeEntry to support rebase-first flow
tasks.description: Add 'rebasing' and 'blocked' to the MergeState type union in types/index.ts. Add conflictingFiles?: string[] to the MergeEntry interface in merge-queue.ts. Update recoverFromDB() to treat 'rebasing' entries as 'pending'. Update retry() to accept 'blocked' state in addition to 'build-failed' and 'conflict'.
acceptanceCriteria: MergeEntry has optional conflictingFiles: string[] field

tasks.title: Restructure MergeQueue.processItem to rebase-first flow
tasks.description: Rewrite processItem() to: (1) Call rebaseOntoMaster() first. (2) If rebase succeeds, proceed to mergeBack (fast-forward) → build verification → cleanup. (3) If rebase has conflicts, abort the rebase via abortRebase(), set mergeState='blocked' with conflict files recorded. (4) Emit merge_blocked event on blocked. Remove the git merge --abort cleanup at start of processItem (no longer needed).
acceptanceCriteria: Clean rebase → fast-forward merge → build verification → merged
Conflict rebase → mergeState='blocked' with conflictingFiles populated
merge_blocked event emitted with conflict details on blocked
Build verification and rollback still work after fast-forward merge
tasks.notes: Agent conflict resolution loop (continueRebase with agent) is deferred — blocked issues can be retried manually. This task only implements: rebase → success? → merge : → blocked.

tasks.title: Add GET /api/issues/merge-blocked endpoint
tasks.description: Add GET /api/issues/merge-blocked route that queries all issues with mergeState='blocked' and returns {issueNumber, title, conflictingFiles, blockedAt} for each. Uses issueRepo or issueService to query blocked issues. Gets conflictingFiles from the MergeQueue in-memory entry when available.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/merge-blocked returns 200 with array of blocked issues
Each entry includes issueNumber, title, conflictingFiles, blockedAt
Returns empty array when no blocked issues exist
Returns 400 when no active project context

tasks.title: Update POST /api/issues/:number/retry-merge to accept blocked state
tasks.description: Update the existing retry-merge endpoint to accept 'blocked' as a retryable state (in addition to 'build-failed' and 'conflict'). The response error message for non-retryable states should include the current mergeState value.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 409 for non-retryable mergeState with current state in error message
Retried issue re-enters merge queue with mergeState='pending'
